title: Taiwan Railway Lets Passengers Buy Tickets Online Five Minutes Before Departure
summaryZh: 台鐵網路購票延至開車前5分鐘，改票放寬至30分鐘前。
summaryHi: ताइवान रेलवे: अब ट्रेन छूटने से 5 मिनट पहले तक ऑनलाइन टिकट, 30 मिनट पहले तक बदलाव।
summaryEs: Ferrocarril de Taiwán permite comprar billetes en línea hasta 5 minutos antes de la salida.
summaryJa: 台湾鉄路、ネット購入を発車5分前まで延長、変更は30分前まで可能に。
summaryKo: 대만철도, 출발 5분 전까지 온라인 예매 가능… 변경은 30분 전까지.
summaryEn: Taiwan Railway now sells tickets online until five minutes before departure and allows changes up to 30 minutes before.
paragraphs: Taiwan's state-run railway operator is giving passengers more flexibility. Taiwan Railway Corporation (TR) announced on Monday that, starting on 10 November, tickets can be bought online as late as five minutes before a train departs, rather than 30 minutes.

The deadline for changing a ticket online has also been relaxed. Passengers will now be able to amend their bookings up to 30 minutes before their original train leaves, compared with the previous cut-off of one hour.

A further improvement concerns the TR mobile app. Under the old rules, a single phone could store only one full-fare ticket alongside several discounted tickets for children or senior citizens. The update removes this restriction, allowing one device to collect multiple tickets in any fare category.
The change should make life easier for families and groups who travel together, since one person will be able to manage everyone's tickets on a single phone.
TR shared the details in a news release, though it did not explain the reasons behind the changes or give a date for the app update.
Taiwan Railway has good news for train riders. From 10 November, people can buy train tickets online until five minutes before the train leaves.
Before, they had to buy tickets at least 30 minutes before the train left. Now they have more time.
There is a second change. People can also change their tickets online until 30 minutes before their train. Before, the limit was one hour.

The railway's phone app will get better too. Soon one phone can hold many tickets of every kind. Before, a phone could hold only one full-price ticket. The other tickets had to be cheap tickets for children or older people.
The railway shared the news on Monday. It did not say when the new app will be ready.

以前，他們必須在火車開車前至少30分鐘買票。
現在他們有更多時間了。
還有第二項改變。
民眾也可以在火車開車前30分鐘為止上網改票。
以前的期限是一小時。
台鐵的手機App也會變得更好。
很快，一支手機就能存放各種類型的多張車票。
以前，一支手機只能存放一張全票。
其他車票必須是給孩童或長者的便宜車票。
台鐵在星期一公布了這個消息。
台鐵沒有說新版App什麼時候會準備好。

paragraphs: Taiwan Railway Corporation, the state-run train company, has made it easier to buy tickets at the last minute. From Tuesday, 10 November, passengers can book tickets online up to five minutes before their train departs.
Until now, the online booking system closed 30 minutes before departure. This could be a problem for travellers who decided to take a train at the last minute.
The company is also giving passengers more time to change their plans. Tickets can now be changed online up to 30 minutes before the original train leaves, instead of one hour.

In addition, the railway's mobile app is being updated. In the past, one phone could only hold one full-price ticket, plus several cheaper tickets for children or seniors. After the update, a single phone will be able to collect several tickets of any type, which should help families and groups.
The company announced the changes in a press release on Monday, but it did not say when the app update will be available.

更新後，一支手機將能領取任何類型的多張車票，這應該會對家庭和團體有幫助。
台鐵於星期一在新聞稿中宣布這些改變，但沒有說明App更新何時上線。

paragraphs: Taiwan's state-run railway operator is giving passengers more flexibility. Taiwan Railway Corporation (TR) announced on Monday that, starting on 10 November, tickets can be bought online as late as five minutes before a train departs, rather than 30 minutes.

The deadline for changing a ticket online has also been relaxed. Passengers will now be able to amend their bookings up to 30 minutes before their original train leaves, compared with the previous cut-off of one hour.

A further improvement concerns the TR mobile app. Under the old rules, a single phone could store only one full-fare ticket alongside several discounted tickets for children or senior citizens. 網路改票的期限也已放寬。
旅客現在最晚可在原訂列車出發前30分鐘修改訂位，先前的截止時間則是一小時。
另一項改善與台鐵手機App有關。
依照舊規定，一支手機只能存放一張全票，以及幾張給孩童或年長者的優惠票。
這次更新取消了這項限制，讓一台裝置可以領取任何票種的多張車票。

paragraphs: Last-minute travellers in Taiwan have reason to celebrate. Taiwan Railway Corporation (TR), the state-owned operator of the island's conventional rail network, has cut the online booking deadline from 30 minutes to just five minutes before departure, with the new rule taking effect on 10 November.

Alongside this, the window for modifying tickets online has been extended. Whereas passengers previously had to make any changes at least an hour in advance, they may now do so up to 30 minutes before their original train is scheduled to leave.

TR is also overhauling its mobile app. Until now, the app imposed a somewhat awkward limit: a single phone could hold only one full-fare ticket, together with any number of concessionary tickets for children or older passengers. Once the update is rolled out, that cap will be lifted, and one device will be able to store multiple tickets across every fare category.
For families and groups, the practical benefit is obvious, as a single organiser will be able to keep all the tickets in one place.
The announcement came in a TR press release on Monday. Notably, the company offered no explanation for the changes, nor did it specify when the revised app would become available.
sentZh: 在台灣臨時決定出門的旅客有理由慶祝了。
經營台灣傳統鐵路網的國營業者臺灣鐵路公司（台鐵），已將網路訂票截止時間從出發前30分鐘縮短到僅五分鐘，新規定自11月10日起生效。
與此同時，網路改票的時段也延長了。
旅客以前必須至少提前一小時辦理任何變更，現在則最晚可在原訂列車預定出發前30分鐘辦理。
台鐵也正在全面改版手機App。
到目前為止，這個App設有一項有點彆扭的限制：一支手機只能存放一張全票，以及任意數量給孩童或年長旅客的優惠票。
一旦更新上線，這個上限將被取消，一台裝置就能存放所有票種的多張車票。
對家庭和團體而言，實際好處顯而易見，因為由一位負責人就能把所有車票集中保管。
這項消息是台鐵於星期一透過新聞稿公布的。
值得注意的是，台鐵沒有解釋做出這些改變的原因，也沒有明確說明改版App何時推出。

paragraphs: Taiwan Railway Corporation (TR), the state-owned company that runs the island's conventional rail services, has introduced a series of measures designed to make ticketing more convenient. Most significantly, passengers will be permitted to purchase tickets online up to five minutes before departure from 10 November, a substantial reduction from the previous 30-minute threshold.

The policy on amendments has likewise been relaxed. Travellers may now alter their reservations online up to 30 minutes before their scheduled train departs, whereas they were previously required to do so at least one hour beforehand.

In addition, TR is upgrading its mobile application. Under the existing system, each phone was restricted to a single full-fare ticket, although it could hold several discounted tickets for children or the elderly. The forthcoming update will eliminate this constraint, enabling users to store multiple tickets of any fare type on one device.
Such changes are likely to benefit families and groups in particular, as they reduce the need for each traveller to manage a separate booking.
The operator announced the adjustments in a press release on Monday. However, it neither outlined the rationale behind them nor confirmed when the upgraded app would be launched.
sentZh: 經營台灣傳統鐵路服務的國營公司臺灣鐵路公司（台鐵）推出一系列措施，旨在讓購票更加便利。
最重要的是，自11月10日起，旅客最晚可在出發前五分鐘上網購票，比先前30分鐘的門檻大幅縮短。
改票政策同樣也放寬了。
旅客現在最晚可在預定列車出發前30分鐘上網更改訂位，而以前必須至少提前一小時辦理。
此外，台鐵正在升級其手機應用程式。
在現行系統下，每支手機只能存放一張全票，不過可以存放幾張給孩童或長者的優惠票。
即將推出的更新將取消這項限制，讓使用者可以在一台裝置上存放任何票種的多張車票。
這些改變可能特別有利於家庭和團體，因為它們減少了每位旅客各自管理訂票的需要。
台鐵於星期一透過新聞稿宣布這些調整。
然而，台鐵既未說明背後的理由，也未確認升級版App何時推出。
